    Loading and Manipulating Data

    We'll start off by loading

    Loading a Test System

    1. Load in a version of the Reliability Test System with time-series for day-ahead modeling:
    system = build_system(PSISystems, "modified_RTS_GMLC_DA_sys");

    1. Use the help function ? to look up information about the RenewableDispatchType

    2. Take a look at what renewable generators are in this power system:

    1. Let's look at more information about the first renewable generator:
    get_component(RenewableDispatch, system, "122_WIND_1")
    RenewableDispatch: 122_WIND_1:
   name: 122_WIND_1
   available: true
   bus: ACBus: Aubrey
   active_power: 0.0
   reactive_power: 0.0
   rating: 7.135
   prime_mover_type: PowerSystems.PrimeMoversModule.PrimeMovers.WT = 22
   reactive_power_limits: (min = 0.0, max = 0.0)
   power_factor: 1.0
   operation_cost: PowerSystems.RenewableGenerationCost composed of variable: InfrastructureSystems.CostCurve{InfrastructureSystems.LinearCurve}, curtailment_cost: InfrastructureSystems.CostCurve{InfrastructureSystems.LinearCurve}
   base_power: 713.5
   services: 0-element Vector{PowerSystems.Service}
   dynamic_injector: nothing
   ext: Dict{String, Any}()
   InfrastructureSystems.SystemUnitsSettings:
      base_value: 100.0
      unit_system: InfrastructureSystems.UnitSystemModule.UnitSystem.SYSTEM_BASE = 0
   has_supplemental_attributes: false
   has_time_series: true
    1. Let's start by looking at the system without it's large-scale renewables by turning them off:
    for g in get_components(RenewableDispatch, system)
    set_available!(g, false)
end
